contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GLORIA EXERCITVS ; D/ CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C

Copper alloy Nummus of Constantine II as Caesar (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads: GLORIA EXERCITVS. Reverse: Two soldiers and two standards. Mint is Trier, AD: 330-331. RIC, VII, p215, no527. Obverse legend reads: CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C. Obverse: Laureate and Cuirassed bust facing right. Die axis:6 o'clock
